title: Character Frequency Lock
description: Given a lowercase string and a frequency k, print all distinct characters that occur exactly k times. Print them in alphabetical order.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; the string contains only lowercase English letters; 1 <= k <= n.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: the string. Third line: k.
outputFormat: Print the qualifying characters without spaces in alphabetical order. Print -1 if none qualify.
hints: Count each character first, then scan the alphabet in order.

examples.explanation: a and c each appear exactly twice.
Only a appears exactly three times.
